task: Resume STEP-02 only to repair the confirmed session/XML interchange defect in the existing lane work. Retain valid existing I/O work and edit only crates/core/src/io/** (ordinarily xml.rs and its owned source-module tests; touch sif.rs only if a visible fixture or fixed format rule directly requires it). Do not edit public types/signatures, Cargo manifests/lockfile, model/layout/alignment/CLI source, protected tests, fixtures, goldens, workflow files, or unrelated I/O behavior. Do not use Docker, Git add/commit, a verifier, benchmark/results paths, or operator-only runtime paths. ROOT's review established that the current XML implementation loses Session.metadata and Session.alignment_scores and converts a Session::from_network containing nodes into Some(layout) after write/read. Repair all three observable contracts: (1) exact preservation of metadata.created_by, saved_at, and description when supplied; (2) exact preservation of each AlignmentScores field (ec, s3, ics, nc, ngs, lgs, js), including reading/writing the visible BioFabric NetAlignMeasure names in plugInDataSets while retaining raw plugin-data round-trip fidelity; and (3) Session::from_network remains layout: None through XML write/read even for a nonempty network, while a real NetworkLayout and its rows/columns/annotations remains Some and is preserved. Read visible BIF fixtures before choosing syntax. Do not silently discard any fixed Session state or invent a contradictory alternate BIF grammar: use compatible optional XML data only where no visible BIF representation exists, parse it defensively, and preserve existing visible fixture behavior. Add focused source-module tests that first establish then protect the three contracts. Audit SIF multi-target input only from visible fixed evidence; repair it and test it only if a directly supported standard/fixture rule proves the present implementation wrong, otherwise leave it alone and state the evidence/result in RESULT.json. Keep parsing state local until success and preserve fixed errors/order. Leave all allowed source edits and a truthful RESULT.json; ROOT will run bridge checks after exit.
acceptance_criteria: Every edit is confined to crates/core/src/io/**, with any new tests inside owned source modules; no public API, manifest, lockfile, protected fixture, golden, or existing protected test changes occur.
A nonempty Session::from_network round-trips through XML with layout == None; a Session::with_layout round-trips as Some(layout) with its layout rows, columns, and annotations preserved.

XML read/write preserves supplied SessionMetadata fields and every AlignmentScores field, maps visible NetAlignMeasure plugin data to those scores, and still preserves raw plugInDataSets data needed for fixture round trips.
Visible BIF fixture grammar and existing valid STEP-02 I/O behavior remain compatible; malformed optional data reaches the fixed ParseError boundary rather than producing partial session state.
RESULT.json truthfully lists changed paths, tests actually run (including red/green if run), any SIF audit evidence, remaining uncertainty, and blockers.
deliverables: A focused repair under crates/core/src/io/** that preserves the complete fixed Session state through XML interchange.
Narrow owned source-module tests for metadata, alignment score/plugin, and bare-versus-laid-out session round trips.
A truthful RESULT.json in the lane worktree.
